item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 12 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 12 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 5:00 AM, 18 August 2026(Tuesday)

RED WARNING LEVEL: Batangas(Balayan, Tuy, Lian, Calatagan, Calaca, Lemery, Laurel, Agoncillo, Talisay, Tanauan, Malvar, Balete, Mataasnakahoy, Batangas City, San Jose, Lipa, Cuenca, San Pascual, San Luis, Bauan, Santa Teresita, Alitagtag, Taal, San Nicolas, Nasugbu, Taysan, Ibaan, Rosario, Padre Garcia, Santo Tomas), Zambales(Botolan, Iba, Cabangan, San Narciso, San Felipe, San Antonio, Subic, Olongapo, Castillejos, San Marcelino) and Bataan(Morong, Hermosa, Dinalupihan, Bagac).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Serious FLOODING in flood-prone areas.

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Cavite, Bataan(Abucay, Balanga, Limay, Mariveles, Orani, Orion, Pilar, Samal), Pampanga(Bacolor, Mexico, Santa Ana, Arayat, Magalang, San Fernando, Angeles, Mabalacat, Floridablanca, Lubao, Santa Rita, Guagua, Porac, Santo Tomas, Minalin, Macabebe, Masantol, Sasmuan), Tarlac(Bamban, Capas, San Jose, Mayantoc, Tarlac City, Concepcion), Zambales(Palauig, Masinloc, Candelaria, Santa Cruz), Laguna(Calamba, Cabuyao, Santa Rosa, Binan, San Pedro, Alaminos, Calauan, Bay, Los Banos, San Pablo), Bulacan(Paombong, Hagonoy), Metro Manila(Muntinlupa, Las Pinas), Batangas(Lobo, San Juan) and Quezon(Tiaong, San Antonio).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is still THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Rizal, Laguna(Lumban, Kalayaan, Liliw, Luisiana, Magdalena, Majayjay, Nagcarlan, Pagsanjan, Pila, Rizal, Santa Cruz, Victoria, Cavinti, Famy, Mabitac, Paete, Pakil, Pangil, Santa Maria, Siniloan), Quezon(Real, Sampaloc, Lucban, Tayabas, Sariaya, Candelaria, Dolores, Lucena), Metro Manila(Caloocan, Malabon, Navotas, Valenzuela, Quezon City, Paranaque, Taguig, Makati, Mandaluyong, Pasig, San Juan, Pasay, Pateros, Marikina, Manila), Bulacan(San Jose del Monte, Santa Maria, Bustos, Pandi, Baliuag, Plaridel, Pulilan, Calumpit, Malolos, Bulakan, Guiguinto, Bocaue, Balagtas, Obando, Meycauayan, Marilao), Pampanga(Apalit, Candaba, San Luis, San Simon) and Tarlac(Anao, Gerona, La Paz, Paniqui, Pura, Ramos, San Manuel, Victoria, Camiling, Moncada, San Clemente, Santa Ignacia).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.


Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Nueva Ecija, Quezon(General Nakar, Infanta, Mauban, Pagbilao, Agdangan, Alabat, Atimonan, Buenavista, Burdeos, Calauag, Catanauan, General Luna, Guinayangan, Gumaca, Jomalig, Lopez, Macalelon, Mulanay, Padre Burgos, Panukulan, Patnanungan, Perez, Pitogo, Plaridel, Polillo, Quezon, San Andres, San Francisco, San Narciso, Tagkawayan, Unisan) and Bulacan(Angat, Dona Remedios Trinidad, Norzagaray, San Ildefonso, San Miguel, San Rafael) which may persist within 3 hours.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 8:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.

item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 11 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 11 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 2:00 AM, 18 August 2026(Tuesday)

RED WARNING LEVEL: Zambales(Olongapo, Subic, Botolan, San Marcelino, Cabangan, Iba, Castillejos, San Antonio, San Felipe, San Narciso, Palauig), Bataan(Morong, Dinalupihan, Hermosa, Bagac), Tarlac(Capas, Bamban, San Jose), Pampanga(Porac, Floridablanca, Mabalacat, Angeles) and Batangas(Calatagan, Lian, Nasugbu, Tuy, Balayan, Calaca, Lemery, Agoncillo, Laurel, San Nicolas, Taal, San Luis, Bauan, Mabini, Tingloy, Santa Teresita, Alitagtag, San Pascual, Batangas City).

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Metro Manila, Rizal, Cavite(General Trias, Trece Martires, Bacoor, Carmona, Cavite City, Dasmarinas, Gen. Mariano Alvarez, Imus, Kawit, Naic, Noveleta, Rosario, Tanza), Laguna(San Pedro, Binan, Los Banos, Bay, Calauan, Alaminos, San Pablo), Tarlac(Anao, Gerona, Paniqui, Pura, Ramos, San Manuel, Victoria, Camiling, Moncada, San Clemente, La Paz), Pampanga(Candaba, San Luis, San Simon, Apalit), Bulacan(Calumpit, Paombong, Hagonoy, Plaridel, Malolos, Pulilan, Bulakan, Guiguinto, Obando, Meycauayan, San Jose del Monte, Santa Maria, Marilao, Bocaue, Balagtas, Pandi, Baliuag) and Quezon(San Antonio, Tiaong, Dolores, Candelaria, Sariaya).

For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
